title: Warm Contrast Media for Pain Reduction During Hystersalpingography
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to compare between body-temperature to room-temperature contrast media used during hysterosalpingography. We hypothesize that warmed medium will reduce pain associated with the procedure.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis: infertility
* sex: female
* age: 18-45

Exclusion Criteria:

* active pelvic inflammotory disease
* known sensitivity to contrast medium
